findings.title: Path Traversal
findings.description: A request parameter (req.params.filename) is passed into path.join() and used to read a file from disk. A traversal sequence could escape the intended directory.

findings.title: Information Exposure Through Error Message
findings.description: Upstream response data is returned to the caller in the error path of the availability sync handler.

findings.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
findings.description: A long base64-like string literal assigned to 'partnerSsoPublicKey' matches the secrets-detection signature for an embedded cryptographic key. Hard-coded keys must not be committed to source control.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: No helmet() / HSTS / CSP / X-Content-Type-Options middleware configured.

findings.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in semver
findings.description: semver < 7.5.2 is vulnerable to ReDoS via the new Range function when untrusted data is supplied as a range.

findings.title: Improper Input Validation / Open Redirect in follow-redirects
findings.description: follow-redirects < 1.15.4 improperly handles URLs in url.parse(), allowing hostname misinterpretation and redirect to an attacker-controlled host.
